correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed GP(10,3) independently on twenty graph vertices and computed every BFS distance; the 190 unordered pairs distribute by distance 1..5 as 30,60,60,30,10. Hence the inclusive graph-vertex Rips complex changes only at integer thresholds. At r=2 independently generated all 260 cliques and read the actual 140-step r2_steps.json: all 120 pair deletions are genuine free-face/coface collapses in the entire active complex, all 20 critical deletions are maximal, and the full 260-node reversed Hasse graph topologically sorts without cycle, leaving one critical vertex and 19 critical 2-cells. At r=3 regenerated all 3,200 cliques and checked the entire actual 1,601-step r3_steps.json: 1,599 legal free-face pair deletions, only a critical vertex and one critical 3-cell, no leftovers, and complete Hasse acyclicity over 3,200 cells. Thus K₂≃wedge^19 S² and K₃≃S³ integrally by elementary collapses and Forman, not by mod-two ranks. K₁ is a connected triangle-free 20-vertex/30-edge graph with cycle rank 11; r<1 is 20 points; at r=4 the ten distance-five pairs are disjoint, so the flag complex is the join of ten S⁰= S⁹; r≥5 is a full simplex. Adjacent stages have homology in distinct degrees, so all reduced persistence groups are free, all consecutive maps vanish, and the claimed half-open integer barcode follows.
